question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A case in which the blade of a sword is kept
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sheath**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sheath **is a covering for the blade of a sword or knife. (तलवार या चाकू के ब्लेड के लिए एक आवरण)
 
• It is used to protect the blade and prevent accidents.
 
• The word can also be used as a verb, meaning to put something in a protective covering or enclosure.
